title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: ACT-CL J0102-4915 "El Gordo," a Massive Merging Cluster at Redshift 0.87

evidence.locator: Sect. III.2.2: the gas is deprojected as rotationally symmetric about an axis chosen to run through the peak X-ray emission at the bullet and the surface-brightness depression toward the north-west, centred on R.A. 01:02:54.9, Dec. -49:15:52.5 and oriented at a position angle of 136 degrees. Sect. III.1: the south-eastern component has a line-of-sight peculiar velocity of 586 +/- 96 km/s with respect to the main north-western one. Sect. IV: the steep fall-off of the X-ray brightness to the south-east and the wake to the north-west indicate that the bullet moves toward the south-east; the collision is likely close to the plane of the sky.
